title: Poisson derivations and cohomology of Poisson nilpotent algebras
summary: We compute the Poisson derivations and the first Poisson cohomology group of uniparameter Poisson Nilpotent Algebras (PNA for short) under the hypothesis that Poisson-normal elements are Poisson-central. This applies in particular to certain Poisson algebras associated to Bott--Samelson varieties.
